Repo: https://github.com/clawdbot/clawdbot. Source `src/` (CLI `src/cli`, commands `src/commands`, provider `src/provider-web.ts`, infra `src/infra`, media `src/media`); colocated `*.test.ts`; docs `docs/`; output `dist/`; plugins `extensions/*`. Keep plugin-only deps in extension `package.json`; do not add them to root `package.json` unless core uses them. Installers: `../clawd.bot/public/install.sh`, `public/install-cli.sh`, `public/install.ps1`.

Consider all built-in + extension channels for shared logic. Core: `src/telegram`, `src/discord`, `src/slack`, `src/signal`, `src/imessage`, `src/web`, `src/channels`, `src/routing`; extensions: `extensions/*`; docs: `docs/channels/`. Mintlify docs: internal links root-relative, no `.md`/`.mdx`; use root-relative anchors. Peter requests full `https://docs.clawd.bot/...` URLs; after touching docs, end reply with referenced full URLs. README links stay absolute. Docs must be generic: no personal device names/hostnames/paths; use placeholders like `user@gateway-host` and “gateway host”.

Node 22+; keep Node + Bun paths working. `pnpm install`; also `bun install` (keep `pnpm-lock.yaml` + Bun patching in sync when touching deps/patches). Prefer Bun: `bun <file.ts>` / `bunx <tool>`. Dev: `pnpm clawdbot ...` or `pnpm dev`. Build/type-check: `pnpm build`; lint: `pnpm lint`; format: `pnpm format`; tests: `pnpm test`; coverage: `pnpm test:coverage`. Run `pnpm lint` before commits and `pnpm test` (or `pnpm test:coverage`) before pushing logic changes. Live: `CLAWDBOT_LIVE_TEST=1 pnpm test:live`, `LIVE=1 pnpm test:live`; Docker: `pnpm test:docker:live-models`, `pnpm test:docker:live-gateway`, `pnpm test:docker:onboard`. See `docs/testing.md`. TypeScript ESM, strict typing; avoid `any`. Use existing CLI/dependency-injection patterns (`createDefaultDeps`); brief comments for tricky logic; keep files concise, ~500 LOC when feasible. Vitest V8 thresholds: 70% lines/branches/functions/statements. Pure test changes need no changelog unless user-facing behavior changes or requested.

Use `scripts/committer "<msg>" <file...>`; avoid manual `git add`/`git commit`. Group related changes; concise action-oriented messages. Changelog: latest release at top, no `Unreleased`; after publishing bump version/start top section. PRs summarize scope, tests, user-facing changes/flags. Issues/PRs: print full URL at task end. GitHub comments use literal multiline strings or `-F - <<'EOF'` (or `$'...'`) for real newlines; never embed "\\n".

PR link review: run `git pull` first; if local changes or unpushed commits, stop and alert user. Review with `gh pr view`/`gh pr diff`; do not change branches. Prefer one `gh pr view --json ...`; diff only when needed. Review mode: read `gh pr view/diff`; do not switch branches; do not change code. Landing: integration branch from `main`; prefer rebase, merge allowed if safer; apply fixes, changelog (+ thanks + PR #), run `pnpm lint && pnpm build && pnpm test` locally before committing; commit, merge to `main`, then `git switch main` (never stay on a topic branch after landing). Contributor must be in git graph. When working on PRs, add changelog PR # and thanks; on issues reference issue. When merging, PR comment explains exactly what was done and includes SHA hashes. New contributor: add avatar to README “Thanks to all clawtributors”; after merge run `bun scripts/update-clawtributors.ts` if missing and commit regenerated README. If review is followed by work, land via merge/squash, no direct-main commits; add PR author as co-contributor. Always try to merge PR unless truly difficult. Squash: add author as co-contributor.
